# Anchorline Global Trade Pvt. Ltd.

> Interior materials supplier for hotels, hospitality projects, interior
designers and architects. Axminster carpet, carpet tiles, broadloom, LVT
flooring, curtain & upholstery fabrics, window blinds, and custom
hand-tufted / hand-knotted rugs. Mumbai-based, supplying pan-India.

## What we do
- Woven Axminster carpet
- Nylon printed carpet (banquet halls, event spaces)
- Nylon carpet tile and broadloom — cut pile and loop pile constructions
- FR-certified carpet tiles
- PP (polypropylene) carpet
- Broadloom carpets
- LVT flooring
- Curtain & upholstery fabrics, made-to-measure curtains
- Window blinds (roller, roman, zebra)
- Custom hand-tufted and hand-knotted rugs, made to a client's brief, sketch or mood board
  - Hand-tufted: 4-6 week lead time
  - Hand-knotted: 12 week lead time

## Who we serve
Hotels and hospitality projects, developers and contractors, interior
designers, and architects - B2B and project supply only, not retail.

## Where we work
Mumbai HQ. Pan-India project supply, with dedicated pages for Pune and Hyderabad.
